title: pvPVDReader
body:
## pvPVDReader

Reads a ParaView .pvd collection: an XML index listing VTK XML data files (.vtu, .vtp, .vti, .vtm, .vtt …) with timestep, part and group attributes. Distinct timestep values become a time series; several parts at one time are combined into a composite (multiblock) output. Use it to reopen results written by pvWriteXMLPVDWriter or by solvers that emit .pvd; for a single VTK XML file use the matching reader such as pvXMLUnstructuredGridReader.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- File names inside the .pvd are normally relative to the .pvd's folder; move the referenced files with it.
- Array lists apply to every referenced file; name arrays explicitly when later nodes depend on them.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `PVDReader`. Identity: `sources/PVDReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CellArrays` | This property lists which cell-centered arrays to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `ColumnArrays` | This property lists which columns to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `FileName` | This property specifies the file name for the PVD reader. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}` | `required` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `PointArrays` | This property lists which point-centered arrays to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvPVDReader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
  }
}
```
